page.content:
Child whose possession is the story's center.

How Regan MacNeil connects

  • Creator: Linda Blair — Linda Blair played Regan MacNeil.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — The 1973 film is the story of Regan's possession.
  • Faction: MacNeil family — Regan is the MacNeil daughter at the story's center.
  • Character: Pazuzu — Regan's body is the site of Pazuzu's possession.
  • Item: Ouija board — Regan first contacts Captain Howdy through the Ouija board.

What is Regan MacNeil?

Regan MacNeil is the twelve-year-old whose personality, body, and voice are taken over, forcing medicine, then the Church, into the house.

Key threads lead to Linda Blair, The Exorcist (1973), MacNeil family, Pazuzu and Ouija board.
